# Generate Within Set Covariance
```{r}
power_law_sigma <- function(c = 1, a = -1, p) {
  i <- seq_len(p)
  c * (i ^ a)
}

generate_within_set_cov <- function(c_x = 1, c_y = 1, a_x = -1, a_y = -1, p_x, p_y) {
  Sigma_x <- power_law_sigma(c_x, a_x, p_x) # Vector
  Sigma_y <- power_law_sigma(c_y, a_y, p_y)
  list(Sigma_x = Sigma_x, Sigma_y = Sigma_y)
}
```

# Generate Orthonormal U and V
```{r}
generate_UV_qr <- function(p_x, p_y, k) {
  
  U_k <- qr.Q(qr(matrix(rnorm(p_x * k), nrow = p_x, ncol = k)), complete = FALSE)
  V_k <- qr.Q(qr(matrix(rnorm(p_y * k), nrow = p_y, ncol = k)), complete = FALSE)
  
  list(U_k = U_k, V_k = V_k)
}
```

# Compute Weights from U and V
```{r}
compute_W_from_UV <- function(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V) {
  
  W_X <- diag(1 / sqrt(Sigma_x)) %*% U
  W_Y <- diag(1 / sqrt(Sigma_y)) %*% V
  
  list(W_X = W_X, W_Y = W_Y)
}
```

# Generate Between Set 
```{r}
compute_Sigma_XY_from_UVS <- function(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V, r_true, k) {
  
  if (k == 1) {
    S <- matrix(r_true, nrow = 1, ncol = 1)
  } else {
    S <- diag(r_true, nrow = k)
  }
  
  Sigma_XY <- diag(sqrt(Sigma_x)) %*% U %*% S %*% t(V) %*% diag(sqrt(Sigma_y))
  
  return(Sigma_XY)
}
```

# Assemble Joint Cov
```{r}
assemble_joint_cov <- function(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, Sigma_XY) {
  
  Sigma_X <- diag(Sigma_x)
  Sigma_Y <- diag(Sigma_y)
  
  Sigma <- rbind(
    cbind(Sigma_X, Sigma_XY),
    cbind(t(Sigma_XY), Sigma_Y)
  )
  
  return(Sigma)
}
```

# Combined Simulator
```{r}
generate_cca_population <- function(c_x = 1, c_y = 1, a_x = -1, a_y = -1,
                               p_x, p_y, r_true) {
  
  r_true <- as.numeric(r_true)
  k <- length(r_true)
  
  # Within set covariances
  covs <- generate_within_set_cov(c_x, c_y, a_x, a_y, p_x, p_y)
  Sigma_x <- covs$Sigma_x
  Sigma_y <- covs$Sigma_y
  
  uv <- generate_UV_qr(p_x, p_y, k)
  U <- uv$U_k
  V <- uv$V_k
  
  W <- compute_W_from_UV(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V)
  W_X <- W$W_X
  W_Y <- W$W_Y
  
  # Between set covariance
  Sigma_XY <- compute_Sigma_XY_from_UVS(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, U, V, r_true, k)
    
  # Joint covariance
  Sigma <- assemble_joint_cov(Sigma_x, Sigma_y, Sigma_XY)
  
  list(
    W_X = W_X,
    W_Y = W_Y,
    p_x = p_x,
    p_y = p_y,
    r_true = r_true,
    joint_cov = Sigma
  )
}
```

# Generate Joint Data
```{r}
generate_joint_data <- function(joint_cov, n, p_x) {
  p_total <- ncol(joint_cov)
  
  Z <- MASS::mvrnorm(n, mu = rep(0, p_total), Sigma = joint_cov)
  
  list(
    X = Z[, 1:p_x],
    Y = Z[, (p_x + 1):p_total]
  )
}
```

# Power
```{r}
compute_power <- function(joint_cov , p_x, n = 100, 
                          num_datasets = 100, 
                          num_permutations = 100,
                          alpha = 0.05, k) {
  
  # num_datasets x k 
  success_bonf <- matrix(0, nrow = num_datasets, ncol = k)

  for (d in 1:num_datasets) {
    
    # Generate datasets 
    data <- generate_joint_data(joint_cov, n, p_x)
    
    r_obs_all <- cancor(data$X, data$Y)$cor[1:k]
    
    # k x num_perm
    r_null_matrix <- replicate(num_permutations, {
      Y_perm <- data$Y[sample.int(n), , drop = FALSE]
      cancor(data$X, Y_perm)$cor[1:k]
    })

    # Calculate p values
    # Computes the number of times the the r_null corr is >= to the corr_obs / num_perm + 1
    for (j in 1:k) {
      p_val_j <- (sum(r_null_matrix[j, ] >= r_obs_all[j]) + 1) / (num_permutations + 1)
      
      if (p_val_j < alpha / k) success_bonf[d, j] <- 1
    }
  }
  
  return(colMeans(success_bonf))
  
}
```

```{r}
compute_power_1d <- function(joint_cov, p_x, n = 100, 
                             num_datasets = 100, 
                             num_permutations = 100,
                             alpha = 0.05) {
  
  success <- numeric(num_datasets)
  
  for (d in 1:num_datasets) {
    
    # Generate dataset
    data <- generate_joint_data(joint_cov, n, p_x)
    
    # Observed canonical correlation (scalar)
    r_obs <- cancor(data$X, data$Y)$cor[1]
    
    # Null distribution (vector)
    r_null <- replicate(num_permutations, {
      Y_perm <- data$Y[sample.int(n), , drop = FALSE]
      cancor(data$X, Y_perm)$cor[1]
    })
    
    # Permutation p-value
    p_val <- (sum(r_null >= r_obs) + 1) / (num_permutations + 1)
    
    # Bonferroni not needed (k = 1)
    if (p_val < alpha) success[d] <- 1
  }
  
  mean(success)
}
```

# Solve CCA
```{r}
solve_cca_dataset <- function(joint_cov, n = 100, p_x, k) {
  
  # Generate data
  data <- generate_joint_data(joint_cov, n, p_x)
  X <- data$X
  Y <- data$Y
  
  # Compute CCA using cancor
  cca_res <- cancor(X, Y)
  
  # Canonical weights
  WX_hat_k <- cca_res$xcoef[, 1:k, drop = FALSE]
  WY_hat_k <- cca_res$ycoef[, 1:k, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Canonical correlations
  r_obs_all <- cca_res$cor[1:k]
  
  # Canonical scores
  scores_X <- scale(X, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) %*% WX_hat_k
  scores_Y <- scale(Y, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE) %*% WY_hat_k
  
  list(
    WX_hat = WX_hat_k,
    WY_hat = WY_hat_k,
    r_obs = r_obs_all,
    scores_X = scores_X,
    scores_Y = scores_Y,
    joint_cov = joint_cov,
    p_x = p_x,
    n = n 
  )
}
```

# Relative Correlation Error
```{r}
relative_error <- function(r_est, r_true) {
  
  (r_est - r_true) / r_true
}
```

# Cossim Similarity
```{r}
cos_similarity_k <- function(W_hat, W_true) {
  
  # Calculates cossim similarity for 2 weight matrices
  
  norm_hat <- sqrt(colSums(W_hat^2)) # Vector
  norm_true <- sqrt(colSums(W_true^2))
  
  # Element wise multiplication and summing over cols
  dot_products <- colSums(W_hat * W_true)

  cos_theta <- dot_products / (norm_hat * norm_true) # Vector
  
  pmin(pmax(cos_theta, -1), 1)
}
```

# Weight Error
```{r}
weight_error_k <- function(WX_hat, WY_hat, WX_true, WY_true) {
  
  # Compute 1 - |cos| for each dimension
  err_X <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(WX_hat, WX_true))
  err_Y <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(WY_hat, WY_true))
  
  # Parallel max
  pmax(err_X, err_Y)
}
```

# Score and Loading Error
```{r}
center_cols <- function(M) sweep(M, 2, colMeans(M), "-")
```

```{r}
score_loading_error_k <- function(cca_fit, WX_true, WY_true) {

  # Generate test data
  test_data <- generate_joint_data(cca_fit$joint_cov, cca_fit$n, cca_fit$p_x)
  
  # Compute scores
  sX_hat  <- test_data$X %*% cca_fit$WX_hat # n x k
  sX_true <- test_data$X %*% WX_true
  sY_hat  <- test_data$Y %*% cca_fit$WY_hat
  sY_true <- test_data$Y %*% WY_true
  
  # Column center
  sX_hat  <- center_cols(sX_hat)
  sX_true <- center_cols(sX_true)
  sY_hat  <- center_cols(sY_hat)
  sY_true <- center_cols(sY_true)
  
  # Score error
  err_score_X <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(sX_hat, sX_true))
  err_score_Y <- 1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(sY_hat, sY_true))
  score_err   <- pmax(err_score_X, err_score_Y)
  
  # Compute loading error
  compute_load_err <- function(X, s_hat, s_true) {
    est_load  <- cor(X, s_hat) # p x k
    true_load <- cor(X, s_true)
    
    est_load  <- center_cols(est_load)
    true_load <- center_cols(true_load)
    
    1 - abs(cos_similarity_k(est_load, true_load))
  }
  
  loading_err <- pmax(
    compute_load_err(test_data$X, sX_hat, sX_true),
    compute_load_err(test_data$Y, sY_hat, sY_true)
  )
  
  list(score = score_err, loading = loading_err)
}
```

# Figure 1
```{r}
# Parameters
p_x <- 8; p_y <- 8
r_true_list <- list(
  "blue"  = c(0.55, 0.5, 0.45),  # Med
  "green" = c(0.25, 0.2, 0.15)  # Low
)
n_per_ftr <- c(3, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000) 
n_reps_datasets <- 100 
n_reps_models <- 10
k_comp <- 3 # Num of canonical pairs

if(!dir.exists("cca_sim_results")) dir.create("cca_sim_results")

# Simulation
for (r_color in names(r_true_list)) {
  r_val <- r_true_list[[r_color]] # Get the correlation vector corresponding to r_color
  message("\n--- Simulation for r_true [", r_color, "] = ", paste(r_val, collapse = ","), " ---")
  
  for (m in 1:n_reps_models) {
    model_filename <- paste0("cca_sim_results/res_r", r_color, "_mod", m, ".rds")
    
    # Generate population model
    model <- generate_cca_population(p_x = p_x, p_y = p_y, r_true = r_val)
    joint_cov <- model$joint_cov
    wX_true <- model$W_X
    wY_true <- model$W_Y
    
    # Empty list to store metrics for all npf
    model_results <- list()
    
    for (npf in n_per_ftr) {
      current_n <- npf * p_x
      
      # Power
      if (npf > 256) {
        pow_res <- rep(1.0, k_comp)
      } else {
        pow_res <- compute_power(joint_cov, p_x = p_x, n = current_n,
                                 num_datasets = n_reps_datasets, num_permutations = 100, k = k_comp)
      }
      
      # Results of computing metrics 100 times
      iter_metrics <- replicate(n_reps_datasets, {
        res <- solve_cca_dataset(joint_cov, n = current_n, p_x = p_x, k = k_comp)
        
        w_err <- weight_error_k(res$WX_hat, res$WY_hat, wX_true, wY_true)
        s_l_err <- score_loading_error_k(res, wX_true, wY_true)
        
        list(assoc = res$r_obs, w_err = w_err, s_err = s_l_err$score, l_err = s_l_err$loading)
      }, simplify = FALSE) # Keep as list of lists
      
      # For each canonical pair take metric average and save results
      for (comp in 1:k_comp) {
        avg_assoc <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$assoc[comp]))
        avg_werr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$w_err[comp]))
        avg_serr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$s_err[comp]))
        avg_lerr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$l_err[comp]))
        
        model_results[[length(model_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          color = r_color,
          r_true_val = r_val[comp],
          component = comp,
          n_per_ftr = npf,
          model_id = m,
          Power = pow_res[comp],
          Association = avg_assoc,
          Weight_Error = avg_werr,
          Score_Error = avg_serr,
          Loading_Error = avg_lerr
        )
      }
    }
    saveRDS(bind_rows(model_results), model_filename)
    message("Saved Model ", m, " for ", r_color)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Load and Prepare Data ---
files <- list.files("cca_sim_results", full.names = TRUE)
df_final <- map_dfr(files, readRDS)

df_plot <- df_final %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Power, Association, Weight_Error, Score_Error, Loading_Error),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, 
                         levels = c("Power", "Association", "Weight_Error", "Score_Error", "Loading_Error")))

# --- 2. Fixed Panel Generator Function ---
make_panel <- function(comp_idx, metric_name, show_y_axis = FALSE, panel_label = "") {
  
  sub_df <- df_plot %>% filter(component == comp_idx, Metric == metric_name)
  
  # Identify true values for the legend
  r_blue  <- sub_df %>% filter(color == "blue") %>% pull(r_true_val) %>% first()
  r_green <- sub_df %>% filter(color == "green") %>% pull(r_true_val) %>% first()
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value, color = color, fill = color)) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1), geom = "ribbon", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("blue" = "#0000CD", "green" = "#00FF7F")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue" = "#0000CD", "green" = "#00FF7F")) +
    # FIXED: Ticks every 100 up to 1000
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(250, 500, 750, 1000)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = -0.05, vjust = -1, size = 14, face = "plain")) +
    labs(title = panel_label)
  
  # Association Row: Dashed lines and "true" labels
  if (metric_name == "Association") {
    p <- p + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = r_blue, color = "#0000CD", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = r_green, color = "#00FF7F", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 60, y = r_blue - 0.04, label = "true", color = "#0000CD", size = 3.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 60, y = r_green - 0.04, label = "true", color = "#00FF7F", size = 3.5) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.8))
  }
  
  # Power Row: FIXED LEGEND POSITIONing for the 1000 scale
  if (metric_name == "Power") {
    # Moved x to ~800 to sit in the white space of the converged lines
    p <- p + 
      annotate("text", x = 750, y = 0.42, label = "italic(r)[true] == phantom(0)", parse = TRUE, size = 4.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 850, y = 0.35, label = sprintf("%.2f", r_blue), color = "#0000CD", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
      annotate("text", x = 850, y = 0.18, label = sprintf("%.2f", r_green), color = "#00FF7F", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.02))
  }
  
  # Error Rows: Standardized Y-limits
  if (metric_name %in% c("Weight_Error", "Score_Error", "Loading_Error")) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.02))
  }
  
  # Hide Y axis for components 2 and 3
  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# --- 3. Building the Layout ---
create_row_label <- function(text) {
  wrap_elements(panel = textGrob(text, rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)))
}

# --- Column Labels ---
col_labels <- lapply(c("Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3"), function(lbl) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = lbl, size = 5) +
    theme_void()
})

# --- Row labels ---
row_labels <- create_row_label("Power") / 
              create_row_label("Association strength") / 
              create_row_label("Weight error") / 
              create_row_label("Score error") / 
              create_row_label("Loading error")

col1 <- (make_panel(1, "Power", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Association", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Weight_Error", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Score_Error", T) / 
         make_panel(1, "Loading_Error", T))

# Construct Column 2
col2 <- (make_panel(2, "Power", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Association", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Weight_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Score_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(2, "Loading_Error", F))

# Construct Column 3
col3 <- (make_panel(3, "Power", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Association", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Weight_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Score_Error", F) / 
         make_panel(3, "Loading_Error", F))

row_labels <- wrap_elements(
  create_row_label("Power") / 
  create_row_label("Association strength") / 
  create_row_label("Weight error") / 
  create_row_label("Score error") / 
  create_row_label("Loading error")
)

final_plot <- wrap_plots(
  # Top row
  plot_spacer(), col_labels[[1]], col_labels[[2]], col_labels[[3]],
  # Bottom row
  row_labels, col1, col2, col3,
  ncol = 4,
  heights = c(0.015, 1),  # smaller top row
  widths = c(0.16, 1, 1, 1)
) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "Samples per feature",
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
  )

# --- 4. Export ---
ggsave("Fig1_3D.pdf", final_plot, width = 10, height = 14)
```

```{r}
# Parameters
p_x <- 8; p_y <- 8

  message("\n--- Simulation for r_true [", r_color, "] = ", paste(r_val, collapse = ","), " ---")
  
  for (m in 1:n_reps_models) {

    # Generate population model

    joint_cov <- model$joint_cov
    wX_true <- model$W_X
    wY_true <- model$W_Y
    
    # Empty list to store metrics for all npf
    model_results <- list()
    
    for (npf in n_per_ftr) {
      current_n <- npf * p_x
      
      # Power
      pow_res <- compute_power_1d(joint_cov, p_x = p_x, n = current_n, 
                                  num_datasets = n_reps_datasets, num_permutations = 100)
      
      # Results of computing metrics 100 times
      iter_metrics <- replicate(n_reps_datasets, {
        res <- solve_cca_dataset(joint_cov, n = current_n, p_x = p_x, k = k_comp)
        
        w_err <- weight_error_k(res$WX_hat, res$WY_hat, wX_true, wY_true)
        s_l_err <- score_loading_error_k(res, wX_true, wY_true)
        
        list(assoc = res$r_obs, w_err = w_err, s_err = s_l_err$score, l_err = s_l_err$loading)
      }, simplify = FALSE) # Keep as list of lists
      
      avg_assoc <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$assoc[1]))
      avg_werr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$w_err[1]))
      avg_serr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$s_err[1]))
      avg_lerr  <- mean(sapply(iter_metrics, function(x) x$l_err[1]))
        
      model_results[[length(model_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        color = r_color,
        r_true_val = r_val[1],
        component = 1,
        n_per_ftr = npf,
        model_id = m,
        Power = pow_res,
        Association = avg_assoc,
        Weight_Error = avg_werr,
        Score_Error = avg_serr,
        Loading_Error = avg_lerr
      )
    }
    saveRDS(bind_rows(model_results), model_filename)
    message("Saved Model ", m, " for ", r_color)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Load Data ---
full_df <- list.files("cca_sim_results_1d", pattern = "*.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  map_df(readRDS)

# --- 2. Process Data ---
plot_df <- full_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Power, Association, Weight_Error, Score_Error, Loading_Error), 
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(color, r_true_val, n_per_ftr, Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_v = mean(Value, na.rm=TRUE),
    low_v = quantile(Value, 0.025, na.rm=TRUE),
    high_v = quantile(Value, 0.975, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# --- 3. Plot Function ---
make_p <- function(metric_name, title_y, show_x = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE) {
  paper_colors <- c("blue" = "#0000CD", "green" = "#00FF7F")
  paper_labels <- c("blue" = "0.5", "green" = "0.1")  # <-- legend labels
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df %>% filter(Metric == metric_name), 
              aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = mean_v, color = color, fill = color)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low_v, ymax = high_v), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = paper_colors, labels = paper_labels, name = expression(r[true])) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = paper_colors, labels = paper_labels, name = expression(r[true])) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    labs(y = title_y, x = if(show_x) "Samples per feature" else NULL) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      axis.text.x = if(show_x) element_text(color = "black") else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = if(show_x) element_line() else element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.6),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 10, b = 2, l = 10)
    )
  
  if(show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.2), legend.background = element_blank())
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# --- 4. Build Panels ---
p1 <- make_p("Power", "Power", show_legend = TRUE)

      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "#0000CD", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1, color = "#00FF7F", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4)

# --- 6. Save ---
ggsave("Fig1_1D.pdf", final_plot, width = 4, height = 15)
```

```{r}
# --- PARAMETERS ---
n_rep_obs <- 100
n_per_ftr_vec <- c(3, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000)

r_true_vec_list <- list(
  c(0.25, 0.2, 0.15),
  c(0.55, 0.5, 0.45),
  c(0.8, 0.75, 0.7)
)

n_sigmas <- 15
ax_ay_val <- -1.0
px_vals_eq <- c(4, 8, 16, 32)
n_cores <- 8
k_comp <- 3

if (!dir.exists("cca_multi_px_results")) dir.create("cca_multi_px_results")

# Creates function
run_stability_batch <- function(px, py, cond_name, r_true) {
  
  k <- length(r_true)
  
  # Updates user on current status
  cat(sprintf("\n--- Condition: %s (px=%d, py=%d) r_true=%s ---\n",
              cond_name, px, py, paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = ",")))
  
  for (mod in 1:n_sigmas) {
    
    file_path <- sprintf("cca_multi_px_results/%s_px%d_r%s_mod%d.rds",
                         cond_name, px,
                         paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"),
                         mod)
    
    if (file.exists(file_path)) next
    
    # Generate population
    model <- generate_cca_population(c_x = 1, c_y = 1, a_x = ax_ay_val, 
                                     a_y = ax_ay_val, p_x = px, p_y = py,
                                     r_true = r_true)
    
    # Loops over sample size (n_per_ftr_vec)
    batch_results <- map_df(n_per_ftr_vec, function(n_ptf) {
      
      n_total <- ceiling(n_ptf * px)
      
      # Power
      if (n_ptf > 256) {
        p_bonf_val <- rep(1.0, k)
      } else {
        p_bonf_val <- compute_power(joint_cov = model$joint_cov, p_x = px,
          n = n_total, num_datasets = n_rep_obs, num_permutations = 100,
          k = k)
      }
      
      # Computes error metric n_rep_obs times
      # For each replication produce df with k rows
      draws <- replicate(n_rep_obs, {
        
        cca_fit <- solve_cca_dataset(joint_cov = model$joint_cov,
          n = n_total, p_x = px, k = k)
        
        rel_assoc_err <- relative_error(cca_fit$r_obs, r_true)
        weight_err <- weight_error_k(cca_fit$WX_hat, cca_fit$WY_hat,
          model$W_X, model$W_Y)
        score_load <- score_loading_error_k(cca_fit, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
        
        data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Rel_Assoc_Err  = rel_assoc_err,
          Weight_Err     = weight_err,
          Score_Err      = score_load$score,
          Load_Err       = score_load$loading
        )
        
      }, simplify = FALSE)
      
      # Average across datasets for same canonical pair
      draws_df <- bind_rows(draws) %>%
        group_by(Canonical_Pair) %>%
        summarise(
          Rel_Assoc_Err = mean(Rel_Assoc_Err),
          Weight_Err    = mean(Weight_Err),
          Score_Err     = mean(Score_Err),
          Load_Err      = mean(Load_Err),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Power_Bonf = p_bonf_val,
          n_per_ftr  = n_ptf
        )
      
      draws_df
    })
    
    # --- Save results ---
    saveRDS(
      batch_results %>%
        mutate(
          px = px,
          py = py,
          r_true = paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"),
          mod = mod,
          cond = cond_name
        ),
      file_path
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("Saved mod %d\n", mod))
  }
}

# Parallel Processing
all_tasks <- expand.grid(
  px = px_vals_eq,
  r_idx = seq_along(r_true_vec_list)
) %>%
  mutate(
    py = px,
    cond = "px_eq_py"
  )

mclapply(1:nrow(all_tasks), function(i) {
  
  task <- all_tasks[i, ]
  
  run_stability_batch(
    px = task$px,
    py = task$py,
    cond_name = task$cond,
    r_true = r_true_vec_list[[task$r_idx]]
  )
  
}, mc.cores = n_cores)
```

```{r}
# --- 3. Panel Function ---
make_per_pair_panel <- function(df_data, comp_idx, metric_name,
                                show_y_axis = FALSE,
                                show_linetype_legend = FALSE) {

  sub_df <- df_data %>% filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx, Metric == metric_name)
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  legend_vals <- r_values_ref %>%
    filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx) %>%
    pull(Value_Str)

  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value,
                        color = val_str, linetype = factor(px))) +  # wrap px in factor
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8)

  p <- p + scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "px",  # <-- sets the legend title
    values = c("4"="dotdash", "8"="dashed", "16"="longdash", "32"="solid"),
    guide = if(show_linetype_legend) "legend" else "none"
  )

  # Correlation legend ONLY for Power row
  if (metric_name == "Power") {
    p <- p + annotation_custom(
      grob = tableGrob(
        d = data.frame(r = legend_vals),
        theme = ttheme_minimal(
          base_size = 8,
          core = list(
            fg_params = list(
              fontface = "bold",
              col = color_map_raw[legend_vals],
              hjust = 0, x = 0.1
            ),
            bg_params = list(fill = NA)
          ),
          rowhead = list(
            fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0, fontface = "italic")
          )
        ),
        rows = c(expression(r[true] == ""), "", ""),
        cols = NULL
      ),
      xmin = 20, xmax = 400,
      ymin = 0.02, ymax = 0.3
    )
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_x_log10(
      limits = c(3, 1100),
      breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
      labels = expression(10^1, 10^2, 10^3)
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(
      limits = c(1e-3, 1.2),
      breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1),
      labels = expression(10^-3, 10^-2, 10^-1, 10^0)
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(values = color_map_raw, guide = "none") +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = expression(px),
      values = c("4"="dotdash", "8"="dashed", "16"="longdash", "32"="solid"),
      guide = if (show_linetype_legend) "legend" else "none"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_linetype_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )

  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank()
    )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Load Data ---
files <- list.files("cca_multi_px_1d_results", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
if(length(files) == 0) stop("No RDS files found!")
df_raw <- map_df(files, readRDS)

# --- 2. Prepare Data for Plotting ---
df_plot <- df_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = any_of(c("Power_Bonf", "Rel_Assoc_Err", "Weight_Err", "Score_Err", "Load_Err")),
    names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    r_true = sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(r_true)),  # color mapping
    px = factor(px, levels = c(4, 8, 16, 32)),
    Metric = factor(Metric,
      levels = c("Power_Bonf", "Rel_Assoc_Err", "Weight_Err", "Score_Err", "Load_Err"),
      labels = c("Power", "Relative assocciation error", "Weight error", "Score error", "Loading error")
    ),
    Value = pmax(Value, 1e-4)  # prevent log(0)
  )

# --- 3. Define Colors and Linetypes ---
color_map <- c("0.10" = "#96F3A6", "0.30" = "#45ADA8", "0.70" = "#00008B")
line_map <- c("4" = "dotdash", "8" = "dashed", "16" = "longdash", "32" = "solid")

# --- 4. Plotting Function ---
make_1d_plot <- function(df, metric_name, show_x = FALSE) {
  
  p <- df %>% filter(Metric == metric_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value,
               color = r_true,
               linetype = px,
               group = interaction(r_true, px))) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = line_map) +
    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
      labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(
      limits = c(1e-3, 1.2),
      breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1),
      labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x))
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = if(show_x) "Samples per feature" else NULL) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# --- 5. Create Row Plots ---
row_plots <- map(levels(df_plot$Metric), ~ make_1d_plot(df_plot, .x, show_x = (.x == "Loading error")))

# --- 6. Add Row Labels ---

  wrap_elements(textGrob(text, rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")))
}
row_labels <- map(levels(df_plot$Metric), make_row_label)
row_labels_plots <- wrap_plots(row_labels, ncol = 1)

# --- 7. Assemble Final Plot (Single Column) ---
final_plot <- wrap_plots(
  row_labels_plots, wrap_plots(row_plots, ncol = 1),
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(0.12, 1),
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

# --- 8. Save ---
ggsave("Fig2_1D.pdf", final_plot, width = 6, height = 15)
```

# Figure 3
```{r}
plan(multisession, workers = 8)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

results_dir <- "cca_px_plus_py_64_results"
if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir)

# ==========================================
# 1. CORE BATCH FUNCTION
# ==========================================
run_stability_batch <- function(px, py, cond_name, r_true, n_rep_obs, n_sigmas, n_per_ftr_vec) {
  k <- length(r_true)
  message(sprintf("\n>>> STARTING: px=%d, py=%d (sum=%d)", px, py, px + py))

  for (mod in 1:n_sigmas) {
    file_path <- sprintf(
      "%s/%s_px%d_py%d_r%s_mod%d.rds",
      results_dir, cond_name, px, py,
      paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), mod
    )
    if (file.exists(file_path)) next

    model <- generate_cca_population(p_x = px, p_y = py, r_true = r_true)

    batch_results <- purrr::map_df(n_per_ftr_vec, function(n_ptf) {
      n_total <- ceiling(n_ptf * px)

      # Skip unstable case
      if (n_total <= max(px, py)) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      # Compute power
      p_raw <- if (n_ptf > 256) rep(1.0, k) else compute_power(
        joint_cov = model$joint_cov,
        p_x = px, n = n_total,
        num_datasets = n_rep_obs,
        num_permutations = 100,
        k = k
      )

      # Replicate for error metrics
      draws <- replicate(n_rep_obs, {
        tryCatch({
          cca_fit <- solve_cca_dataset(model$joint_cov, n_total, px, k)
          if (is.null(cca_fit)) return(NULL)
          rel_err <- relative_error(cca_fit$r_obs, r_true)
          weight_err <- weight_error_k(cca_fit$WX_hat, cca_fit$WY_hat, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          score_load <- score_loading_error_k(cca_fit, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          data.frame(
            Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
            Rel_Assoc_Err = rel_err,
            Weight_Err = weight_err,
            Score_Err = score_load$score,
            Load_Err = score_load$loading
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }, simplify = FALSE)

      draws <- draws[!sapply(draws, is.null)]
      if (length(draws) == 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      dplyr::bind_rows(draws) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Canonical_Pair) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Power_Raw = p_raw, n_per_ftr = n_ptf)
    })

    saveRDS(
      batch_results %>% dplyr::mutate(px = px, py = py, mod = mod, r_true_label = paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), cond = cond_name),
      file_path
    )
    cat(sprintf("   Saved mod %d/%d (px=%d, py=%d)\n", mod, n_sigmas, px, py))
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 2. TASK GRID
# ==========================================
n_rep_obs <- 100
n_per_ftr_vec <- c(3, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000)
r_true_vec_list <- list(c(0.25,0.2,0.15), c(0.55,0.5,0.45), c(0.8,0.75,0.7))
n_sigmas <- 15
px_vals <- c(4, 8, 16)

all_tasks <- expand.grid(px = px_vals, r_idx = seq_along(r_true_vec_list))
all_tasks$py <- 64 - all_tasks$px
all_tasks$cond <- "px_plus_py_64"

# ==========================================
# 3. PARALLEL EXECUTION
# ==========================================
results <- future_lapply(1:nrow(all_tasks), function(i) {
  task <- all_tasks[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("\n[Task %d/%d] px=%d, py=%d\n", i, nrow(all_tasks), task$px, task$py))
  tryCatch({
    run_stability_batch(
      px = task$px, py = task$py, cond_name = task$cond,
      r_true = r_true_vec_list[[task$r_idx]],
      n_rep_obs = n_rep_obs, n_sigmas = n_sigmas, n_per_ftr_vec = n_per_ftr_vec
    )
    "OK"
  }, error = function(e) {
    msg <- sprintf("FAILED: px=%d py=%d | %s", task$px, task$py, e$message)
    cat(msg, "\n")
    msg
  })
}, future.seed = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 3. PANEL FUNCTION (Legend Shifted Right)
# ==========================================
make_per_pair_panel <- function(df_data, comp_idx, metric_name,
                                show_y_axis = FALSE,
                                show_linetype_legend = FALSE) {

  sub_df <- df_data %>% filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx, Metric == metric_name)
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  legend_vals <- r_values_ref %>%
    filter(Canonical_Pair == comp_idx) %>%
    pull(Value_Str)

  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value,
                          color = val_str, linetype = px_f)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8)

  if (metric_name == "Power") {
    p <- p + annotation_custom(
      grob = tableGrob(
        d = data.frame(r = legend_vals),
        theme = ttheme_minimal(
          base_size = 8,
          core = list(
            fg_params = list(fontface = "bold", col = color_map_raw[legend_vals], hjust = 0, x = 0.1),
            bg_params = list(fill = NA)
          ),
          rowhead = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0, fontface = "italic"))
        ),
        rows = c(expression(r[true] == ""), "", ""),
        cols = NULL
      ),
      # CHANGED: xmin from 20 to 100, xmax from 400 to 800 to shift right
      xmin = 100, xmax = 800, ymin = 0.02, ymax = 0.3
    )
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(3, 1100), breaks = c(10, 100, 1000), labels = expression(10^1, 10^2, 10^3)) +
    scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-3, 1.2), breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1), labels = expression(10^-3, 10^-2, 10^-1, 10^0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map_raw, guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("4" = "dotted", "8" = "dotdash", "16" = "dashed", "32" = "solid"),
      labels = c("4" = "4", "8" = "8", "16" = "16", "32" = "32"),
      guide = if (show_linetype_legend) "legend" else "none"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_linetype_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )

  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  }
  return(p)
}

# ==========================================
# 4. BUILD & LAYOUT (Revised for Clipping & Spacing)
# ==========================================
metrics_levels <- levels(df_plot$Metric)
panel_list <- list()

for (r_idx in seq_along(metrics_levels)) {
  for (c_idx in 1:3) {
    show_legend <- (r_idx == 1 && c_idx == 1)
    name <- paste0("panel_", r_idx, "_", c_idx)
    
    # We remove the custom 'Samples per feature' logic from inside the loop
    # to avoid overlapping with the legend
    p_temp <- make_per_pair_panel(df_plot, c_idx, metrics_levels[r_idx], (c_idx == 1), show_legend)
    
    panel_list[[name]] <- p_temp
  }
}
```

# Figure 3 (1 Component)
```{r}
plan(multisession, workers = 8)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)

results_dir <- "cca_px_plus_py_64_1d_results"
if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir)

# ==========================================
# 1. CORE BATCH FUNCTION
# ==========================================
run_stability_batch_k1 <- function(px, py, cond_name, r_true, n_rep_obs, n_sigmas, n_per_ftr_vec) {
  k <- 1
  message(sprintf("\n>>> STARTING: px=%d, py=%d (sum=%d)", px, py, px + py))

  for (mod in 1:n_sigmas) {
    file_path <- sprintf(
      "%s/%s_px%d_py%d_r%s_mod%d.rds",
      results_dir, cond_name, px, py,
      paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), mod
    )
    if (file.exists(file_path)) next

    model <- generate_cca_population(p_x = px, p_y = py, r_true = r_true)

    batch_results <- purrr::map_df(n_per_ftr_vec, function(n_ptf) {
      n_total <- ceiling(n_ptf * px)

      # Skip unstable case
      if (n_total <= max(px, py)) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1:k,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      # Compute power
      p_raw <- if (n_ptf > 256) 1.0 else compute_power_1d(
        joint_cov = model$joint_cov,
        p_x = px, n = n_total,
        num_datasets = n_rep_obs,
        num_permutations = 100
      )

      # Replicate for error metrics
      draws <- replicate(n_rep_obs, {
        tryCatch({
          cca_fit <- solve_cca_dataset(model$joint_cov, n_total, px, k)
          if (is.null(cca_fit)) return(NULL)
          rel_err <- relative_error(cca_fit$r_obs, r_true)
          weight_err <- weight_error_k(cca_fit$WX_hat, cca_fit$WY_hat, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          score_load <- score_loading_error_k(cca_fit, model$W_X, model$W_Y)
          data.frame(
            Canonical_Pair = 1,
            Rel_Assoc_Err = rel_err,
            Weight_Err = weight_err,
            Score_Err = score_load$score,
            Load_Err = score_load$loading
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }, simplify = FALSE)

      draws <- draws[!sapply(draws, is.null)]
      if (length(draws) == 0) {
        return(data.frame(
          Canonical_Pair = 1,
          Power_Raw = NA,
          Rel_Assoc_Err = NA,
          Weight_Err = NA,
          Score_Err = NA,
          Load_Err = NA,
          n_per_ftr = n_ptf
        ))
      }

      dplyr::bind_rows(draws) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Canonical_Pair) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Power_Raw = p_raw, n_per_ftr = n_ptf)
    })

    saveRDS(
      batch_results %>% dplyr::mutate(px = px, py = py, mod = mod, r_true_label = paste(round(r_true, 2), collapse = "-"), cond = cond_name),
      file_path
    )
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 2. TASK GRID
# ==========================================
n_rep_obs <- 100
n_per_ftr_vec <- c(3, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1000)
r_true_vec_list <- list(c(0.1), c(0.3), c(0.7))
n_sigmas <- 10
px_vals <- c(4, 8, 16)

all_tasks <- expand.grid(px = px_vals, r_idx = seq_along(r_true_vec_list))
all_tasks$py <- 64 - all_tasks$px
all_tasks$cond <- "px_plus_py_64"

# ==========================================
# 3. PARALLEL EXECUTION
# ==========================================
results <- future_lapply(1:nrow(all_tasks), function(i) {
  task <- all_tasks[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("\n[Task %d/%d] px=%d, py=%d\n", i, nrow(all_tasks), task$px, task$py))
  tryCatch({
    run_stability_batch_k1(
      px = task$px, py = task$py, cond_name = task$cond,
      r_true = r_true_vec_list[[task$r_idx]],
      n_rep_obs = n_rep_obs, n_sigmas = n_sigmas, n_per_ftr_vec = n_per_ftr_vec
    )
    "OK"
  }, error = function(e) {
    msg <- sprintf("FAILED: px=%d py=%d | %s", task$px, task$py, e$message)
    cat(msg, "\n")
    msg
  })
}, future.seed = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 3. PANEL FUNCTION (Updated for bottom X-axis label)

make_panel <- function(df_data, metric_name, show_y_axis = FALSE, is_last_panel = FALSE) {
  sub_df <- df_data %>% filter(Metric == metric_name)
  if (nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(ggplot() + theme_void())

  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = n_per_ftr, y = Value, color = val_str, linetype = px_f)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(3, 1100), breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
                  labels = expression(10^1, 10^2, 10^3)) +
    scale_y_log10(limits = c(1e-3, 1.2), breaks = c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1),
                  labels = expression(10^-3, 10^-2, 10^-1, 10^0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map_raw, guide = "legend") + 
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("4" = "dotted", "8" = "dotdash", "16" = "dashed", "32" = "solid"),
      labels = c("4" = "4", "8" = "8", "16" = "16", "32" = "32")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = if (is_last_panel) element_text(size = 11) else element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    ) +
    # This adds the label text specifically if it's the last panel
    labs(x = if (is_last_panel) "Samples per feature" else NULL)

  if (!show_y_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                   axis.line.y = element_blank())
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ==========================================
# 4. BUILD & LAYOUT
# ==========================================
metrics_levels <- levels(df_plot$Metric)

# We check if the metric is the last one in the levels list
panel_list <- map(metrics_levels, function(m) {
  is_last <- (m == tail(metrics_levels, 1))
  make_panel(df_plot, m, show_y_axis = TRUE, is_last_panel = is_last)
})
```
